claim.claim-text: 2. The plasma guide wire (10) according to claim 1, wherein the third insulating resin tube (33 -Fig. 3; 35, 36, 37 - Fig. 4) is disposed so as to prevent the first insulating resin tube (31) from making contact with the core shaft (22).

3. The plasma guide wire (10) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the third insulating resin tube (33 -Fig. 3; 35, 36, 37 - Fig. 4) extends rearwardly relative to the rear end of the first insulating resin tube (31).

4. The plasma guide wire (10) according to claim 3, further comprising a second insulating resin tube (32) disposed on an outer periphery of the core shaft (22), wherein the second insulating resin tube (32) extends rearwardly relative to the rear end of the first insulating resin tube (31) to a rear end side of the core shaft (22).
5. The plasma guide wire (10) according to claim 4, wherein the second insulating resin tube (32) is harder than the first insulating resin tube (31).

6. The plasma guide wire (10) according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the third insulating resin tube (33 -Fig. 3; 35, 36, 37 - Fig. 4) is disposed throughout at the region of the inner periphery of the first insulating resin tube (31), the region being located rearwardly relative to the position facing the rear end of the coil (24).
7. The plasma guide wire (10) according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the tip (26) is formed by welding the front end of the core shaft (22) and the front end of the coil (24).
